name: Stonks
author: Gaurav Chande
description: Your stocks watchlist in the Omarchy bar, each price as it traded: in its own currency, on its exchange's clock, and with its time when it's late. Stonks follows stocks, ETFs, indexes and crypto from New York to London and Tokyo, with pre-market, after-hours and US overnight prices. They come from Yahoo Finance and Robinhood, with no account or API key. Made for Omarchy 4.5.

barWidget.description: Today's move for the stock you last looked at, with its chart a click away.

schema.label: Pill
schema.description: How the pill looks in the center or left section of a top or bottom bar. Right-click the pill to change it.

schema.label: Pill on the right
schema.description: How the pill looks in the right section of a top or bottom bar, among the bar's icons. Right-click the pill there to change it.

schema.label: Pill on a side bar
schema.description: How the pill looks on a bar at the side of the screen: an icon for the day's move, or the symbol over its change. Right-click the pill there to switch.
